福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・東區

台南知事官邸The Tainan Magistrate Residence

未來的日本天皇，就睡在這裡。1923 年 4 月 20 日夜裡，皇太子裕仁下榻這座「時鐘樓」。他欣賞了宋江陣表演，還品嚐了屏東木瓜。官邸完工於 1900 年，原是台南縣知事的官邸。1901 年廢縣置廳後閒置；1920 年台南州成立，它成為州知事官邸。它同時兼作「御泊所」，供總督巡視與皇族來訪時下榻。當地人暱稱它「時鐘樓」，可能因為山牆上有一枚形似時鐘的圓形裝飾。在拱廊牆上，找找「蟲痕飾」和「燕子磚」。早期磚窯燒木柴，煙在磚上燻出黑色斜紋，恰似燕子的尾巴。戰後，它先後當過鹽務總局、地政事務所、民防指揮所與東區區公所。

This is where the future Emperor of Japan slept. On the night of April 20, 1923, Crown Prince Hirohito stayed in this Clock Tower House. He watched a Song Jiang Battle Array performance and tasted a papaya from Pingtung. The house was completed in 1900 as the residence of the Tainan County Governor. It was left empty in 1901. In 1920, it became the residence of the Governor of the new Tainan Prefecture. It was also the official lodging for the Governor-General and for visiting members of the imperial family. Locals call it the Clock Tower House, likely after a round clock-like ornament on the gable. On the arcade walls, look for the worm trail grooves and the swallow bricks. Early kilns burned wood. The smoke left black diagonal stripes on the bricks, like a swallow's tail. After the war, it served as the Salt Affairs Bureau, a land office, a civil defense command center, and the East District Office.

一分鐘看懂

One-minute intro

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history

台南知事官邸是日治時期地方首長的官邸，也是皇族與總督來台南時下榻的「御泊所」。1923 年皇太子裕仁曾在此過夜。拱廊上的燕子磚與蟲痕飾，是欣賞日治洋風建築的好例子。

The Tainan Magistrate Residence housed the region's top official in the Japanese era and also hosted visiting royals. Crown Prince Hirohito stayed here in 1923. Look for the swallow-tail bricks and wormlike grooves on its arcades.

  1. 1900官邸完工，原為台南縣知事官邸。The residence is completed for the governor of Tainan County.
  2. 1920台南州成立，成為州知事官邸。Tainan Prefecture is formed, and it becomes the prefect's residence.
  3. 1923皇太子裕仁 4 月 20 日夜宿於此。Crown Prince Hirohito spends the night of 20 April here.
  4. 戰後 After 1945先後作為鹽務總局、地政事務所、民防指揮所與區公所。It serves as a salt office, a land office, a civil defense post and a district office.
  5. 1998／2010列為古蹟，修復後重新開放。Listed as a monument in 1998 and reopened in 2010.

認識景點

About the place

知事：治理地方的官員。這座官邸是為台南縣知事蓋的。 知事、總督：一個地區的首長。1920 年，新成立的台南州知事住在這裡。 下榻處、住所：住宿的地方。這裡是皇族來訪時下榻的御泊所。 皇太子：將來要當天皇的皇子。皇太子裕仁 1923 年 4 月 20 日夜宿於此。

magistrate: An official who governs an area. The house was built for the Tainan County Governor. governor: The head of a region. In 1920, the Governor of the new Tainan Prefecture lived here. lodging: A place to stay. The house was the official lodging for visiting members of the imperial family. Crown Prince: The son who will become emperor. Crown Prince Hirohito stayed here on the night of April 20, 1923.

山牆裝飾：牆頂三角形山牆上的裝飾。這裡的是圓形的，像時鐘。 時鐘樓：在地人對官邸的暱稱，可能來自那枚像時鐘的圓形飾。 拱廊：建築旁一整排的拱圈走廊。官邸前後都有拱廊。 蟲痕飾：拱廊牆上蜿蜒的溝紋，像蟲子鑽行留下的路徑。

gable ornament: A decoration on the triangle-shaped top of a wall. Here it is round, like a clock. the Clock Tower House: The locals' nickname for the residence, likely after the round clock-like ornament. arcade: A row of arches along a building. This house has arcades front and rear. worm trail: Wandering grooves on the arcade walls, like the paths of burrowing insects.

燕子磚：磚上有黑色斜向煙燻紋，看起來像燕子的尾巴。 窯：燒磚用的大爐子。早期的磚窯以木材為燃料。 瑕疵、缺陷：小小的缺點。煙燻紋本是瑕疵，卻升格成了裝飾。 樓梯：建築裡的樓梯。進到官邸裡，主角就是那道樓梯。

swallow bricks: Bricks with black diagonal smoke stripes that look like a swallow's tail. kiln: A big oven for firing bricks. Early kilns here burned wood. imperfection: A small fault. The smoke stripes were an imperfection, promoted to ornament. staircase: A set of stairs inside a building. Inside the house, the staircase is the star.

古蹟：因歷史價值受保護的地方。官邸 1998 年列為古蹟，2010 年重新開放。 竹園町：日治時期日本官員的官舍區。清代這一帶在一片竹林的西邊，叫「西竹圍」；日治時期取名「竹園町」。知事官邸也在竹園町一丁目。 榻榻米：用草編成的地墊。和室用榻榻米的張數算大小，例如 4.5 疊、6 疊、8 疊。 緣側：房間和庭院之間的木頭走廊，可以坐著看庭院。

historic site: A place protected for its history. The house became a historic site in 1998 and reopened in 2010. Zhuyuan-cho: A Japanese-era housing area for officials. In the Qing era, it lay west of a bamboo grove. In the Japanese era, it was named Zhuyuan-cho, bamboo garden town. tatami: Tatami are mats of woven straw. Rooms are measured in mats. engawa: An engawa is a wooden veranda between the rooms and the garden.

玄關：進門的地方：在玄關脫鞋，再踏上架高的地板。 床之間：和室牆上內凹的小空間，掛掛軸、擺花。 架高地板：地板架高、地基開通風口，讓空氣在地板下流動；台灣潮濕，這樣房子才不會潮濕。 竹園町：「竹園町」日文念作 Takezono-chō，意思是「竹子園子的町」。日治時期，這一帶有許多官舍，大多住著臺南州廳的職員，例如州知事官邸和州內務部長官舍（今原臺南廳長官邸）。附近還留著一棟 1935 年蓋的木造宿舍，住過州廳財務課、稅務課的官員，2016 年登錄為歷史建築，2019 年修復完成。清代這一帶在一片竹林的西邊，叫「西竹圍」。

genkan: This is the genkan. Take off your shoes here before you step up into the house. tokonoma: A tokonoma is an alcove for a hanging scroll and flowers. raised floor: The floor is raised, and vents let air flow under it. This keeps the house dry in Taiwan's humid weather. Takezono-cho: In Japanese, Zhuyuan-cho is read Takezono-cho. It means bamboo garden town. In the Japanese era, many officials of Tainan Prefecture lived here. Nearby, a wooden dormitory from 1935 still stands. It was restored in 2019.

實景照片

Photos on site

沿著小路走到官邸 Up the path

沿著小路走向知事官邸：這是一棟兩層樓的紅磚洋樓，上下兩層都有一整排拱廊，拱圈之間是米色、有凹凸花紋的灰泥板，屋頂正中間是三角形的山牆。路旁還有一排修剪成圓球的樹。

Walk up the path to the Magistrate Residence. This two-story red brick house has arcades on both floors. Look for the triangle-shaped gable on top, and the round trees along the path.

紅磚拱廊 Brick arcades

知事官邸在 1900 年完工，是兩層樓的英國殖民地式洋樓，四周圍著紅磚拱廊。看看拱圈上方有凹凸紋路的灰泥板！

The Magistrate Residence was completed in 1900. Red brick arcades run around this two-story colonial house.

拱廊走廊 Arcade corridor

走進拱廊下的走廊：一邊是紅磚拱柱，一邊是裝著木頭百葉窗的窗戶。

Under the arcade, a corridor runs between the brick arches and the windows with wooden shutters.

百葉窗 Wooden shutters

官邸的一扇綠色木框窗，兩旁是咖啡色的木頭百葉窗。百葉窗的葉片斜斜的，可以擋住陽光和雨水，又能讓風吹進來。

This green window has brown wooden shutters on both sides. Their slanted slats keep out the sun and rain, but let the breeze in.

官邸室內 Inside the residence

官邸裡的一個房間：長長的木桌、皮椅和吊燈，腳下是木頭地板。

Inside the residence, there is a long wooden table with leather chairs and chandeliers.

官邸長餐桌 The long dining table

官邸裡的長餐桌：深綠色絨布桌巾和椅套，中間鋪著米色織錦桌旗，每個座位都擺著日式的陶瓷碗盤、托盤和茶杯。牆壁是藍綠色的木板，後面是展示櫃。現在這裡是餐飲和選物的空間。

The long dining table inside the residence. Dark-green velvet covers the table and chairs, a cream brocade runner lies down the middle, and each place is set with Japanese-style ceramic bowls, trays and teacups. The walls are teal wooden panels, with a display shelf behind. Today the house is used as a restaurant and shop.

榻榻米和室 Tatami room

竹園町宿舍的和室：地上鋪著榻榻米，木框玻璃拉門外就是庭院。這棟木造宿舍建於 1935 年，住過臺南州的稅務職員；2016 年登錄為歷史建築，現在是一間茶屋。

A tatami room in the Zhuyuan-cho dormitory, built in 1935. Glass sliding doors with wooden frames open onto the garden.

緣側與庭院 Veranda and garden

沿著房子的木頭平台，就像日式房子的「緣側」：一邊是玻璃拉門，一邊是庭院。找找看石頭水缽、紅色紙燈籠和庭院小路。

A wooden veranda runs along the house, like an engawa, between the glass doors and the garden. Look for the stone water basin and the red paper lanterns.
